figurative_meaning_en: A narrow, pitch-dark chamber or cell
example_sentences_in_bangla: শত্রুদের অন্ধকূপে বন্দী করে হত্যা করা হতো।
সেই অন্ধকূপের মতো অন্ধকার ঘরে সে ভয়ে কাঁপছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: Enemies were imprisoned and killed in the blind well.
He was trembling in fear in that pitch-dark room like a blind well.
history: Refers to dark, narrow wells or pits historically used in Bengal for secret executions or hiding during feudal times.
note: Often associated with clandestine murders in medieval Bengali contexts.
